status: PRE-REGISTERED - written BEFORE any Phase-9 baseline measurement or optimization
purpose: Freezes the exact workload definitions Phase 9 measures against, per the governing directive's Step 5.
exclusions: No Phase-10 final held-out benchmark case (does not exist in this repository)

No case reused verbatim from Phase 7/8 DEV/Validation Run 1/Validation Run 2 or phase5_benchmark_manifest.json - fresh real-world compounds/conditions chosen throughout, matching this project's established hygiene even though Phase 9 measures system performance, not gold-label quality

A_functional_performance.purpose: Representative successful end-to-end cases, one per required category, for the unoptimized baseline (Step 6) and stage-level profiling (Step 7).

cases.query: What does the literature say about finerenone in diabetic kidney disease outcomes?
cases.expected_shape: single-source (pubmed) real answer, likely sufficient_evidence at round 0

cases.query: What does ClinicalTrials.gov show about trials of zanidatamab in HER2-positive biliary tract cancer?
What does ChEMBL report about the molecular target of zanubrutinib?
What does the literature say about lorlatinib in ALK-positive NSCLC, what does ClinicalTrials.gov show about ongoing trials, and what does ChEMBL report about its mechanism?
cases.expected_shape: pubmed + clinical_trials + chembl in a single round, likely sufficient_evidence at round 0

cases.query: What does ChEMBL report about mirikizumab's mechanism of action, and what does the literature say about mirikizumab in ulcerative colitis?
cases.expected_shape: designed to bias the initial native-tool-call toward one source, leaving a real gap for exactly one live follow-up round (same query-design pattern validated live in Phase-8 local-closure LOCAL-01/03)

cases.query: What does the literature say about aficamten in hypertrophic cardiomyopathy, what does ClinicalTrials.gov show about aficamten trials, and what does ChEMBL report about aficamten's mechanism?
cases.expected_shape: 3-source request, plausibly requiring 2 follow-up rounds (same pattern validated live for niraparib in Phase-8's LOCAL-04, 2 real rounds)

cases.query: What is known about the fictitious compound QRVX-40417-NOTREAL for a condition with no real biomedical evidence anywhere?
cases.expected_shape: zero real Evidence found, SAFE_ABSTENTION (same pattern validated live in Phase-8's LOCAL-08)

cases.query: What does the literature say about tirzepatide in obesity management, and what does ClinicalTrials.gov show about tirzepatide obesity trials?
cases.expected_shape: a well-studied, heavily-published compound/condition pair likely to produce many overlapping/duplicate records across an initial call and any follow-up round (same pattern observed live and unprompted in Phase-8's LOCAL-02, 364 real duplicates)

additional_repeated_case.rationale: one representative case repeated 5x total to obtain a genuine same-workload latency distribution (mean/median/min/max/std dev) - still far below n=30, explicitly NOT eligible for a P95/P99 claim, reported as raw per-run values per the measurement contract's own rule

B_concurrency.independence_rationale: each targets a distinct real compound/condition pair, no shared state dependency between cases (per-case fresh MedAgent() instance per docs/v2/PHASE9_INITIAL_AUDIT.md's confirmed evaluation-harness pattern), safe to run concurrently by construction

C_fault_matrix.purpose: Controlled timeout/429/5xx/malformed-response/source-failure/provider-failure cases - pre-registered here, EXECUTED in Step 8 (systematic reliability matrix), not in Steps 6-7.
C_fault_matrix.note: Full case list, injection method, and exact fault classes are specified in artifacts/v2/phase9_fault_matrix.json (written in Step 8), reusing the same safe network-boundary injection method validated in Phase 8's CTL-017 pass (never abusive real-world traffic against the real public APIs).

D_stress_boundedness.purpose: Cases exercising repeated action, duplicate-only retrieval, retry amplification, research-budget exhaustion, and maximum loop depth - pre-registered here, EXECUTED in Step 11 (worst-case call bounds) and Step 8 (reliability matrix), not in Steps 6-7.
